title: Faculty — WhiteHouse College of Business & Technology
description: WhiteHouse College of Business & Technology — Kathmandu University affiliated BIT and B.Tech Ed IT programs in Jhapa, Nepal.

paras: Our faculty and academic leaders guide students through practical, KU-aligned learning experiences.
Premises of Nidi Secondary School & Indreni Campus

blocks.heading: What faculty do at WCBT
paras: Faculty are responsible for more than classroom delivery. They guide academic progress, mentor projects, coordinate practical learning, and help students connect theory with workplace expectations.

groups.title: Teaching and academic guidance
text: Faculty members plan classes around Kathmandu University-aligned learning outcomes, explain core concepts, run practical sessions, and support students who need extra academic help. Students can approach faculty for subject clarification, assignment guidance, project direction, and exam preparation.

groups.title: Project and career preparation
text: Faculty help students move from theory to application through lab work, presentations, team assignments, research exposure, and career-oriented feedback. This support builds confidence for internships, graduate study, teaching, technical roles, and entrepreneurship.

blocks.heading: Meet our faculty and academic leaders
paras: Educators and coordinators focused on student success, learning quality, and campus engagement.

groups.title: Arya Bhattarai
text: Leads day-to-day academic administration and campus coordination.

groups.title: Aarohi Basnet
text: Coordinates admissions support, student engagement, and extracurricular activities.

blocks.heading: How students work with faculty
paras: The faculty relationship is designed to be practical, accessible, and focused on progress.

groups.title: Subject Support
text: Students receive clarification on topics, assignments, lab work, and assessment expectations.

groups.title: Project Mentoring
text: Faculty guide students through project planning, research, presentation, and improvement.

groups.title: Class Coordination
text: Academic leaders coordinate schedules, notices, student concerns, and learning support.

groups.title: Progress Guidance
text: Students are encouraged to discuss academic challenges before they become setbacks.

blocks.heading: What faculty expect from students
bullets: Attend classes, labs, and academic activities consistently.
Ask questions early when topics, assignments, or expectations are unclear.
Participate in projects, presentations, workshops, and collaborative learning.
Use feedback from faculty to improve academic work and professional readiness.

blocks.heading: Have an academic question?
paras: Contact the college team for program and faculty support.
